name: isomorphic_bliss (canonical-form isomorphism test via the shared I-R engine)

benchmarks.note: Self-isomorphism of C_n: the verdict canonicalizes both graphs (two independent I-R searches) then compares certificates, so cost is ~2x the single-graph canonical_permutation/count_automorphisms baseline on the same symmetric C_n tree, plus an O(n^2/64) certificate compare
